outcome: Photoplethysmographic digital pulse wave analysis variables
cohort: 61 healthy pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section in spinal anesthesia
finding: While both oxytocin and carbetocin had similar vasodilatory effects, oxytocin transiently decreased heart rate and had a sustained negative inotropic effect, whereas carbetocin led to higher vasopressor use due to a more persistent hypotensive effect.
